item.title: Foundation For Housing : Christmas On The Streets
item.description: Directed by Lola Quivoron, with cinematography by Paul Guilhaume, Christmas on the Street places Santa Claus in stark contrast with the realities of life on the street. Beneath the glow of holiday lights, a far grimmer reality emerges — one in which people without housing are forced to constantly seek food, shelter, and safety, echoing the film’s message: “On the streets, you survive by any means. But the best is to leave it behind.” VIEW THE SPOT

item.title: Grand Frais: Slice of Indulgence
item.description: A film that offers a slice of indulgence, built around a familiar seasonal dilemma, resisting the festive meal before the big day... After a gourmand gives in to temptation, unable to resist just a taste of the panettone, the foie gras, the cheese that lies await in the fridge, he is relieved to discover that Grand Frais has created an entire range of decorative covers perfectly designed to cleverly hide the evidence. VIEW THE SPOT

item.title: Bakara Hospital : Many Hands
item.description: Over 15 years since first traveling to rural Kenya to help build Baraka Hospital, Klick Health went back to partner with the hospital and local healthcare professionals in helping provide access to 1,600 life-changing surgeries for people across the country’s Mara region. The partnership is the focus of the company’s just-released ‘Many Hands’ holiday video, a story about the power of community. VIEW THE SPOT

item.title: Movember : Where the Money Goes
item.description: Movember’s new global brand film, “Where the Money Goes”, stars Matt Berry (What We Do in the Shadows, Toast of London).The 14-minute digital film takes an unconventional approach: Berry sits in an armchair doing literally nothing, while key information about where donor money goes scrolls up the screen. It’s a humorous, engaging way to show the real-world impact of Movember’s fundraising on men’s mental health, suicide prevention, prostate cancer, and testicular cancer. VIEW THE SPOT

item.title: Ocean Blue: Coldest Waters
item.description: In Australia, most salmon is sourced locally from Tasmania. But Ocean Blue's salmon comes from the coldest waters of Norway. Home to the world's tastiest salmon - because the colder the water, the better the salmon.To spruik the benefits, we enlisted Hans and Lars. Two Norwegian fishermen that don't agree on much, other than where the best salmon in the world comes from. VIEW THE FOUR SPOTS

item.title: Irish Blood Transfusion Service: O Negative Thank You
item.description: Working with the Irish Blood Transfusion Service, TBWAIreland delivered a heartfelt thank you to 18,733 O negative donors across Ireland.O negative is the blood type that can be transfused to patients of any group, meaning it accounts for 16% of demand in Irish hospitals. O negative donors are vital to the IBTS and are frequently called upon to give blood.
